name: quenching
description: Marketplace hosting quenching as eight modules: quenching-specs (the spec cycle, git and the one cq tool) plus quenching-align, -design, -ops, -proof, -toolchain, -delivery and -security for the docs/ OKF bundle, .claude/ automation, /.design/ source, operations, verification, toolchain, delivery and security fronts, alongside the read-only specs reader and the HUD.

plugins.name: quenching-specs
plugins.description: The spec-driven cycle and its git hand-offs: /quenching-specs:specs:* (create, develop, execute, conclude, triage, status), /quenching-specs:git:* and /quenching-specs:handoff, the verifier agents, and the one cq command-line tool every other quenching module routes through. Enable it alone for a provider-owned backlog; the other modules add their fronts beside it.

plugins.name: quenching-align
plugins.description: The repository-wide align and the two knowledge fronts it conducts first: /quenching-align:align over every enabled module, the docs/ OKF bundle (/quenching-align:knowledge:*) and the .claude/ automation surface (/quenching-align:components:*). Fronts whose module is not enabled are reported not-installed, never invoked. Requires quenching-specs for cq.

plugins.name: quenching-design
plugins.description: The /.design/ source front: /quenching-design:design:* aligns and reports the design source a repository declares. Requires quenching-specs for cq.

plugins.name: quenching-ops
plugins.description: The declared-operations front: /quenching-ops:ops:* aligns and reports the operations registry a repository declares. Requires quenching-specs for cq.

plugins.name: quenching-proof
plugins.description: The verification front: /quenching-proof:proof:* aligns and reports the proof layers a repository declares. Requires quenching-specs for cq.

plugins.name: quenching-toolchain
plugins.description: The toolchain front: /quenching-toolchain:toolchain:* aligns and reports the toolchain a repository declares. Requires quenching-specs for cq.

plugins.name: quenching-delivery
plugins.description: The delivery front: /quenching-delivery:delivery:* aligns and reports the delivery surfaces a repository declares. Requires quenching-specs for cq.

plugins.name: quenching-security
plugins.description: The read-only security pillar: /quenching-security:security:* reports the security posture a repository declares, without a local align. Requires quenching-specs for cq.

plugins.name: quenching-opensource
plugins.description: The open source front: /quenching-opensource:opensource:* reports every owner's catalog answers and the baseline level, and writes license, community and governance artifacts from pinned templates. Requires quenching-specs for cq.

plugins.name: quenching-specs-reader
plugins.description: Read-only view of another project's provider-owned quenching specs: one command, /quenching-specs-reader:read, that a target (an Obsidian vault reading its to-do list, for example) enables alone, without the full quenching plugin. Its cq-specs-read entry admits only read verbs and disables every backend write. Its payload and version are generated from plugins/quenching.

plugins.name: quenching-hud
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: the worktree's active quenching spec, its stage and task progress, read through cq specs status --no-fetch. Runs only git branch --show-current and cq specs status; writes no spec or branch and never fetches: it reads the local refs/remotes/origin/quenching, so the band can lag the remote.
